03 / Legendary Matches

Classics Hall

Only officially logged matches rated 4½ stars or higher qualify. Eight classics are recorded.

1984 · Open Classics Hall (8 matches)
5.0 ★ · GOAT Match · #1

THE REALIGNMENT ROYAL RUMBLE

Jan 6, 1984 · Miami

André the Giant won the Realignment Royal Rumble, last eliminating Stan Hansen. The victory established an early defining moment of the unified WWF era.

Result: André the Giant

4.5 ★ · Instant Classic · #2

THE FABULOUS FREEBIRDS vs. THE WILD SAMOANS

Jan 9, 1984 · Battlegrounds #002 · Boston Garden

The teams' first WWF meeting. A highly rated tag-team encounter that earned a place in the Classics Hall.

Result: Result not verified

5.0 ★ · GOAT Match · #3

RODDY PIPER vs. THE IRON SHEIK vs. JERRY LAWLER

Prime Time · Episode unverified

Piper emerged victorious from a three-way battle with the Iron Sheik and Jerry Lawler.

Result: Roddy Piper

4.5 ★ · Instant Classic · #4

THE ROAD WARRIORS vs. RIOT ACT

Prime Time #002

Hawk and Animal defeated Riot Act (Roddy Piper and Cowboy) in Prime Time's first recognized classic.

Result: The Road Warriors

4.5 ★ · Instant Classic · #5

MICHAEL HAYES vs. MR. PERFECT vs. JIM NEIDHART

Battlegrounds #003 · Boston Garden

A brutal triple threat in which all three competitors were bloodied. Hayes defeated Mr. Perfect to claim the win.

Result: Michael Hayes

5.0 ★ · GOAT Match · #6

RIOT ACT vs. THE VON ERICH BROTHERS

Battlegrounds · Post-Ascension

Riot Act defeated the Von Erich Brothers in a five-star tag-team contest.

Result: Riot Act

5.0 ★ · GOAT Match · #7

The Von Erich Brothers vs. The Road Warriors

Prime Time · Third week of February 1984

Kevin and Kerry Von Erich defeated Road Warrior Hawk and Road Warrior Animal in a five-star tag-team classic.

Winners: The Von Erich Brothers

4.5 ★ · Instant Classic · #8

Ric Flair (c) vs. Bret Hart

WWF Intercontinental Championship · 1984 · Date not yet verified

Flair survived two submission attempts from Bret Hart before winning cleanly by submission.

Winner: Ric Flair · Championship retained

04 / The legacy ledger

Superstar Legacy Scores

Only superstars who have earned legacy points through documented championship reigns, Classics Hall appearances, or eligible pay-per-view victories appear here. Ranked by legacy score. Every WWF wrestler starts with a 0–0 PPV record, including wrestlers not yet shown on this leaderboard.

How legacy is scored

+25 per championship reign · +1 per day as champion · +5 per confirmed successful title defense · +10 per 4½-star Instant Classic appearance · +20 per 5-star GOAT Match appearance · +10 per officially designated pay-per-view victory.

Successful defenses are credited only when verified; a retention by disqualification or count-out does not earn the bonus. * marks Randy Savage’s provisional score based on his estimated 10-day Intercontinental Championship reign. ? means defense count pending verification. A dash means not applicable. Tag reigns and verified team defenses credit both partners. For PPVs, a win earns +10 points for each victorious wrestler (including each winning tag-team partner); losses earn 0 points. A PPV victory may stack with a successful title defense or match-quality bonus. A premium live event only counts as a PPV if it is officially designated as a paid broadcast. The inaugural WWF Ascension was a free event, so none of its matches count toward PPV records or PPV bonuses.
